sources.text: Kim-McManus Precision Therapeutics Neuro-Interventional Lab Discovery, Development, and Delivery of Novel Genetic Therapeutics Discover Our Research Learn More Support Our Work Donate Today Previous Next About Dr. Kim-McManus Dr. Kim-McManus is a physician scientist and Associate Clinical Professor of Neurosciences funded by NIH/NCATS and the California Institute for Regenerative Medicine specializing in pediatric neurology, epilepsy, and clinical neurophysiology at Rady Children’s Institute for Genomic Medicine and UCSD. She directs Rady’s Batten Disease: Precision Therapeutics Neuro-Interventional Program, focusing on targeted therapies including antisense oligonucleotides for rare genetic neurological disorders in children. Her work, which includes clinical trial leadership and n=1 regulatory expertise, is supported by major health and advocacy organizations. She holds leadership roles on numerous national advisory and research committees. Learn More About the OKM Lab
